title: YASAKANI bench result
description: One file per measured engine and setting, written by bench/bench.py and read by bench/compare.py. The speed of a run is (completion_tokens - 1) / (gen_ms / 1000): the time from the first to the last chunk that carried text, with the prompt reading excluded. See bench/README.md.

schema_version.description: Format version. compare.py refuses a file it does not know.

engine.description: Name of the engine, as it should appear in the comparison table (for example yasakani, vllm, llama.cpp).

model.description: Model id sent in the request body.

base_url.description: OpenAI-compatible base URL that was driven, for example http://127.0.0.1:8000/v1.

started_at.description: Local time when the first request was sent, ISO 8601 with an offset.

max_tokens.description: Answer limit of every run. compare.py refuses to mix files with different values.

settings.description: Sampling settings as sent. null means the field was not sent at all.

prompts.description: Task name to SHA-256 of the prompt file. This is the prompt-set fingerprint: compare.py refuses to mix files whose fingerprints differ.

tasks.description: Task names in the order they were run.

gpu.description: What nvidia-smi said when the run started. Empty strings and nulls when it was not available.

runs.description: One entry per request, in the order they were sent.

ttft_ms.description: Time from sending the request to the first chunk that carried text.

gen_ms.description: Time from the first to the last chunk that carried text.

wall_ms.description: Time from sending the request to the end of the stream, prompt reading included.

finish_reason.description: stop, length, tool_calls, or null when the server sent none.

flags.description: Reasons this run must not be averaged in. Empty when the run is clean.

loop_period.description: Length in characters of the repeated unit when flags contains loop.

loop_tail.description: Last characters of the text of a run flagged loop, for a human to look at.

per_task.description: Task name to its tally over the runs that were not flagged.
